I replied to Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell.

The answer comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, which Marcus can see. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. The cause was the same trailer showing up twice at 06:30: the driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch added him manually. I added that Dana owns the account and said they would look into it separately.

I couldn't find a ticket number or any later update on the issue in what Marcus can see. The same Aug 20 thread also mentions a seat count, but Marcus didn't ask about it, so I left it out.
